parsed.summary: The PR adds a new attribute `refit_time_` to measure the time taken to refit the best model. The change is minimal and well-structured.

issues.description: The import statement for `time` is placed inside the method, which is not a common convention in scikit-learn. It should be placed at the top of the file.
The documentation for the new attribute `refit_time_` is missing from the class docstring.
